title: When does the clock run out?

probes.question: Unix time is the number of seconds elapsed since which moment?
options: The first web page going online

probes.question: A signed 32-bit Unix time can store times up to January ____.

image.alt: Rows of green eight-digit binary numbers on a black background.

body.question: Unix time counts seconds since 1 January 1970 and is often stored in a signed 32-bit integer. When does that counter reach its maximum?
body.reveal: A signed 32-bit integer can store at most 2,147,483,647 seconds after the epoch, which is 03:14:07 UTC on 19 January 2038. One more second causes integer overflow, flipping the sign bit to indicate a negative number. One fix is to store time in a signed 64-bit integer.
